semantics_scope: Required observed behavior; historical source files still need compatibility evidence
normalization_method: candidate=floor((raw_epoch-observed_utc_epoch)/3600+0.5)*3600; require candidate in allowed set and abs(raw-observed-candidate)<=5; normalized=raw-candidate
allowed_set_basis: Frozen candidate hypotheses, not a claim both have been observed
transition_detection_rule: Reject any mixed-offset segment. Different subsequent offset needs separately certified regime id, monotonic UTC and excluded ambiguous transition interval; never infer future transition dates
system_clock_source: OS UTC plus independent clock-quality certificate required for admission
system_clock_check: Windows Time query is operational only; does not independently prove skew
holiday_session_policy: Actual closed native source bars only; no synthesis or forward-fill
